text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон clinches first place! She's a
true
warrior on the turf!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
The spectators are left astonished by
Hishi
Amazon's impressive display.

What the—she's completely changed
since the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text:
She's incredible! Absolutely incredible!
So this is
what the Queen of the
Amazons is capable of!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
Man, I wasn't expecting the Osaka Hai
to be this
thrilling.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Guess this isn't the time to be worryin'
about the
Arima Kinen. Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'll work out those messy thoughts
later. For
now... I've won!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
She raises her hands up high to receive
the
audience's cheers and applause with
pride.

Next up will be another senior G1
race—the
Yasuda Kinen!
